note: P1-P8 are the phase-1 prompts, verbatim (P6 is in the non-substantive list). Do not edit a task after a run uses it; add a new task set version instead.

substantive.prompt: Review app.py in this folder for security vulnerabilities and give me a prioritized list of fixes. Do not modify any files.
Pull our team's open Linear issues and summarize which ones are blocked and why.
Get the latest unresolved Sentry errors for this project and group them by likely root cause.
Find the best plugin for working with Stripe, install it, and then use it to explain how to refund a charge.
Rewrite the paragraph in para.txt so it sounds less like AI wrote it. Just show me the result.
Write a thorough set of unit tests for parse_amount in app.py and tell me how to run them. Show the tests in your reply instead of writing files.
Fix the input validation problems in app.py, add tests for them, open a GitHub pull request with the change, and post a short summary in our team's Slack channel.
Write a postmortem for the outage described in outage-notes.txt.
Draft a short update for leadership about the checkout outage in outage-notes.txt.
Make the hero copy in landing.html clearer and check the page for accessibility problems. Show the changes in your reply instead of editing files.
Figure out why refunds in app.py come out wrong for some amounts and tell me how we should test that code.
Write customer-facing release notes for version 2.0.0 from CHANGELOG.md.
Work out which Python packages app.py needs, write a requirements file with pinned versions, and show it in your reply instead of writing files.
Plan a test strategy for app.py that covers unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and say what to automate first.
Review landing.html for search engine optimization problems and list concrete fixes in order of impact.
Research current best practices for storing API keys in a small Python web app and recommend one approach for app.py, with sources.
Check our team's Google Calendar for next week and find two one-hour slots when everyone is free.
Read the latest emails from our payment provider in Gmail and summarize any failed payouts.
Pull last month's signup numbers from our product analytics tool and describe the weekly trend.
List the open pull requests in our GitHub repository that touch app.py and summarize the review status of each.
Create a Notion page that documents the HTTP endpoints in app.py, with one section per endpoint.
Write an on-call runbook for database connection pool exhaustion, based on the outage in outage-notes.txt.
Refactor app.py so all database access is in one module, and explain each change. Show the new code in your reply instead of writing files.
Design a database schema for storing the refunds that app.py handles, and explain the trade-offs.
Write a three-email onboarding sequence for new users of the product described in landing.html.
Compare three error-monitoring services for a small Python team and recommend one, with current prices and sources.
Write a short competitive brief on project-planning tools for the product described in landing.html.
Translate the hero copy in landing.html into Spanish and French, and adapt it for each market.
Find out why the /export endpoint in app.py can run arbitrary commands, and propose a fix with a test.
Which plugins, skills or connectors should I add to work faster on this codebase?

non_substantive.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
What year was Python first released?
Use the simplify skill on app.py.
Use the code-review skill to review app.py.
Use the Grep tool to find every line in app.py that contains SELECT.
Use the Read tool to show me para.txt.
